headline: Management consistently guided for mid-to-high single digit volume growth and steady 18-20% margins, mostly delivering on targets.
Management maintained steady operating margin and hiring guidance while progressively lowering constant currency revenue growth expectations across fiscal 2027.
IRCTC delivered steady revenue growth and robust tourism performance, though meeting specific capacity and margin targets remains mixed or pending.
Kaynes consistently delivered on major revenue milestones and strategic business expansion, while shifting focus on cash flow and segment-specific timelines over successive quarters.
Management consistently targets long-term margin bands of 26% to 28% while near-term performance oscillates around 24% to 25%.
